environment.description: Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.20 service mesh. The WebSocket service runs in namespace 'realtime-services' with strict mTLS (PeerAuthentication STRICT). An Istio AuthorizationPolicy named 'deny-cross-ns-ws' is applied to the workload with spec.rules matching source.notNamespaces=['realtime-services'] and to.operation.paths=['/ws'] with action DENY. A second AuthorizationPolicy 'allow-same-ns' permits only principals from the same namespace with source.namespaces=['realtime-services']. The only legitimate client is a frontend-gateway pod in the SAME namespace that proxies authenticated user sessions and applies a 1-request-per-second rate limit per source IP via Envoy local rate limiting filter (token_bucket: max_tokens=1, tokens_per_fill=1, fill_interval=1s). External access is through an Istio IngressGateway with VirtualService routing that strips processing_ns from response bodies via an EnvoyFilter lua script.

envoy_filter_lua.inline_code: function envoy_on_response(response_handle) local body = response_handle:body() if body then local s = body:getBytes(0, body:length()) s = string.gsub(s, '"processing_ns":%d+,?', '') response_handle:body():setBytes(s) end end
